shots.focal_element: Black-and-white Notion cube logo centred on an off-white field, with a mouse cursor
shots.transition_other: none: first shot of the video (anchors report no incoming transition)
shots.what_happens: A mouse cursor glides from the lower left up to the centred Notion logo and appears to click it; the click triggers the zoom-through into the blue Notion AI face screen (visible in the final sampled frame at 1.0 s).
shots.build_rebuild: Render the Notion logo centred on an off-white background, animate an OS-style cursor along an eased path from bottom-left to just under the logo over ~0.8 s, then on a click frame scale the next scene up from the logo position.

shots.focal_element: Notion AI line-drawn face icon in a white circle with a thick black outline, centred on a saturated blue field
shots.what_happens: The Notion AI face mascot sits centred on full-bleed blue; its facial line-art changes expression between frames (eyebrow/eye strokes shift, as if winking or glancing), giving the character a moment of life before the cut.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a white circle with a thick black stroke at centre of a solid blue frame and swap or morph the SVG face strokes (eyebrows, eyes) over ~1 s to create a small expression change.

shots.composition_other: centred headline first, then a left-aligned static phrase with a cycling pill chip to its right, then a centred icon row that shrinks under a centred two-line headline
shots.focal_element: Bold sans headline text, then the cycling action chip after 'One AI tool to', then the row of app icons (Notion, Slack, Google Docs, Slides, Sheets)
on_screen_text: Find answers from all your apps
shots.typography: Bold geometric/grotesk sans for headlines, sentence case, tight tracking; 'new' set in bold italic with a hand-drawn underline stroke. Action chips use a lighter regular-weight sans in small grey-filled rounded pills with a leading icon. Font guess (low confidence): Inter or Notion's own sans.
shots.what_happens: 'Meet the new Notion AI' rises in line by line (masked from below), then an underline draws on under the italic 'new'. Cut within the shot to 'One AI tool to' with a pill chip whose label cycles vertically with motion blur through Ask a question, Find in Google Drive, Find in Slack, Summarize, Improve writing and Draft a meeting agenda, the outgoing chips fading and blurring above/below. The chip resolves into plain text 'do it all.' which fades from grey to black. The text then clears (a stray stroke is visible at 9.0 s), five app icons pop in one by one in a row, then shrink and move down beneath a centred headline 'Find answers from all your apps'.
shots.build_rebuild: Build three sequential type cards on an off-white background: a masked line-by-line headline reveal with an SVG underline draw-on, a fixed phrase plus a pill chip whose label swaps every ~0.5 s via a vertical blur slide, and a staggered pop-in of five app icons that then scales down and translates below a fading-in two-line headline.

shots.focal_element: Notion AI chat panel on the left with the prompt input, beside a large Notion AI face icon on blue on the right
shots.transition_other: Anchors flag a non-standard transition; at 2 fps the first frame already shows the split UI-over-blue layout with a light strip at the panel edge, so the exact move (likely a slide/push of the UI card in) cannot be confirmed
on_screen_text: Hello Sam! How can I help?
Ask a question about this page
Any updates on the mobile improvements project?
shots.typography: Clean UI sans at product scale (regular weight, sentence case, default tracking); suggestion labels have a bold verb ('Summarize') followed by regular grey text. Font guess (low confidence): Inter / system UI sans.
shots.what_happens: A Notion AI chat panel floats over a blurred Notion page with charts, next to a big mascot face on blue. The greeting and suggestion list are shown while the prompt 'Any updates on the mobile improvements project?' types into the input with a caret. On the last sampled frame the view has zoomed in on the panel: the prompt is now a sent message bubble and the AI starts 'Scanning Notion...'.
shots.build_rebuild: Recreate the AI chat panel as a rounded white card with soft shadow over a dimmed page on the left half, the mascot circle on blue on the right, type the prompt character by character with a blinking caret, then on send push the camera in on the panel and show the message bubble plus a 'Scanning Notion...' status row.

shots.focal_element: The AI status row beside the mascot avatar, cycling through source names under the user's message bubble
on_screen_text: Any updates on the mobile improvements project?
shots.typography: UI sans, regular weight, sentence case; the status line is mid-grey with an animated trailing ellipsis in multicolour dots; user message in dark text inside a light grey rounded bubble.
shots.what_happens: Close-up on the chat panel: the status label swaps from 'Scanning Notion...' to 'Scanning Slack...' to 'Scanning Google Drive...', each with its app icon, while the mascot avatar's face animates and the ellipsis dots pulse.
shots.build_rebuild: Frame the chat card large in view and cycle a status row (app icon + 'Scanning <App>' + three coloured pulsing dots) every ~0.6-0.8 s, swapping the label with a short fade while the avatar face strokes animate.
